Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 5.96% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc bought 1,812 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 32,220 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.41 million, up from 30,408 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tiemann Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.23B market cap company.
